claim_text: An American military parade, seen around the 4th.
quote: I see a military parade. It's around the 4th
falsify_match: A military parade held in America on or near 4 July 2026.
falsify_miss: None held. The 250th anniversary parade was already announced, so the event is public rather than revealed.

claim_text: A red wave and an unexpected change in California called for Monday, with voter fraud uncovered there, and Texas remaining strong.
quote: MONDAY to be it will be a red wave in California
falsify_match: A Californian political reversal or fraud disclosure on the Monday following.
falsify_miss: Nothing on that Monday. He gives a day here, which is rarer than the usual red wave language.

claim_text: He says the banging will stop and calls restore over Europe.
quote: I'm looking over Europe. Restore. Restore. Restore
falsify_match: Nothing. No event is named.
falsify_miss: Nothing. A declaration without content.

claim_text: The red wave over California will shock and awe people, who are fed up with the governor.
quote: It will shock and awe the people
falsify_match: An upset Republican result in California.
falsify_miss: California votes as it has since 2006 for governor.

claim_text: He offers a free Bible to anyone in America who emails, and gives the nightly count of those who said the sinner's prayer as forty three today against sixty two yesterday.
quote: all 43 of you that just said the sinner's prayer
falsify_match: Nothing forward-looking.
falsify_miss: Nothing forward-looking. Recorded because these are the few plain numbers about the operation.

claim_text: A named healing evangelist will hold meetings at a church in Tennessee next weekend, Sunday through Wednesday.
quote: he is going to be in Tennessee at Harvest Church
falsify_match: The meetings take place as scheduled.
falsify_miss: They do not. An announcement from a published itinerary, not a word.

claim_text: He and his wife prayed over moving part-time to Branson and buying a theatre there, a fifteen hundred seat auditorium for prayer meetings and healing services, as a central American location for a named evangelist.
quote: a 1,500 seat auditorium to hold prayer meetings
falsify_match: The purchase of a Branson theatre of about that size by his ministry.
falsify_miss: No purchase. This is a claim about his own actions, so it can be checked directly.

claim_text: He reads a report that ISIS has called on Muslims to set fire to churches and synagogues across America and Europe for Easter Sunday, and says this is what the Lord showed them about Passover, Good Friday and Easter, two of which have passed.
quote: This is what the Lord showed us. Remember I told you?
falsify_match: Arson attacks on churches or synagogues over Easter weekend 2026.
falsify_miss: None. He is reading a same-day news item and matching it to an earlier warning, which is the priority question.

claim_text: Revival spreads all over Colombia through nearly a thousand stirred-up pastors, then through Brazil, Argentina, Venezuela and Cuba, with South America on fire.
quote: Colombia is about to have the greatest revival this world has ever seen
falsify_match: A measurable surge in South American church growth traced to Colombia.
falsify_miss: No surge. Latin American Protestant growth has been high for decades, which sets the base rate.

claim_text: A landslide, with a bald-headed man and a man in glasses he does not recognise, and the Lord showing more fraud in California than in Minnesota.
quote: There was more fraud in Florida than what there was in Minnesota
falsify_match: Confirmed Californian fraud exceeding the Minnesota cases in scale.
falsify_miss: It does not exceed them. He says Florida and corrects himself to California mid-sentence.

claim_text: More corruption in California than in Minnesota, which will be uncovered, illustrated with a report of a hundred and forty six billion dollars of fraud in a single Californian Medicaid programme.
quote: There was more corruption in California than what there was in Minnesota
falsify_match: Further Californian fraud findings at that scale.
falsify_miss: None. The figure he cites is read off a broadcast on the day, not seen beforehand.

claim_text: He reads a report of a hospice fraud in Anaheim, fifty million and seven million dollars, where more than ninety seven per cent of patients lived over five years.
quote: their center has been a problem for years
falsify_match: Nothing. He is reading a news report.
falsify_miss: Nothing. Recorded so the read-out is not mistaken for a word.

claim_text: A major asteroid is coming which they think could miss, but it will not miss and will hit, and it is called wormwood.
quote: A major asteroid is coming and they think it could miss, but they're wrong
falsify_match: An asteroid impact on the earth.
falsify_miss: No impact. No tracked object currently carries a meaningful impact probability.

claim_text: Chinese scientists are more accurate about the asteroid than the Americans and were moving in a panic, the elite know something is coming and one built a bunker, and it will hit in the Atlantic Ocean.
quote: it will hit in the Atlantic Ocean
falsify_match: An ocean impact in the Atlantic.
falsify_miss: No impact. The bunker story is widely reported and predates this.

claim_text: God will shake Cuba and bring the bride to his side, but through great pressure, which many will call an Ichabod because they think God has abandoned them.
quote: I'm going to shake the nation. I'm going to bring the bride to my side
falsify_match: Upheaval in Cuba followed by church growth.
falsify_miss: Neither. The pressure clause means a bad outcome can be read as part of the word.

claim_text: Three major wells of revival in Cuba, one in the far west, one in the middle and one toward the east, each a gusher said never to run dry, with churches birthed around them.
quote: there were three major wells of revival
falsify_match: Three large congregations arising in those three regions of Cuba.
falsify_miss: They do not arise. The three regions cover the whole island, which weakens the placement.

claim_text: An old woman in a prayer shawl travailing for Cuba, and a witchcraft spirit thick over the nation whose back the Lord says he is breaking, departing like a storm parting as the glory comes on the land.
quote: I'm breaking the back of the witchcraft upon Cuba
falsify_match: Nothing observable on its own.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. It can only be scored through the revival claims it is paired with.

claim_text: He names a Miami pastor who has the largest church in Cuba and is over something at the White House, and told him he would have missionary teams going there.
quote: I already have the largest church in Cuba
falsify_match: Missionary teams sent to Cuba by that ministry.
falsify_miss: None sent. He gets the man's name wrong twice while telling it.

claim_text: He told that pastor he would have two more churches, matching the other two wells, with creative miracles, arms growing out, eyes coming back and the dead raised, and the greatest harvest Cuba has known about to spring forth.
quote: Well, you'll have two more
falsify_match: That ministry plants two further large Cuban churches.
falsify_miss: It does not. The two more churches is the countable part of the three wells.

claim_text: People flood into Cuba, the fountains of wealth are restored so it is no longer a third world country but like America, with hotels and a car industry, and the Secretary of State leads the charge.
quote: It was like a third world country that was no more
falsify_match: Cuban living standards approaching American levels.
falsify_miss: They do not. Like America is the strongest form he has given this, and the furthest from the base rate.

claim_text: He says the tornado warnings and watches in Oklahoma are what he saw happening, and asks for five inches of rain without destructive hail or wind.
quote: It actually is happening what I saw
falsify_match: The named rainfall without severe hail or wind damage.
falsify_miss: Damaging storms follow. Early April tornado watches in Oklahoma are near-annual, which sets the base rate.

claim_text: A prayer for the people of Japan and what he sees concerning the land, without saying what it is.
quote: We thank you, Lord, Father, what I see concerning the land
falsify_match: Nothing. He withholds the content.
falsify_miss: Nothing. No claim is made.

claim_text: Taiwan will remain strong and China will not overthrow them because China is bound, with the number seven highlighted, big and bold, trying to fade and marked with stripes like scratches.
quote: We thank you Lord for Taiwan that they will remain strong
falsify_match: Taiwan stays free of Chinese control.
falsify_miss: China takes Taiwan. This sits directly against his own two-day fall word, which is why both are kept.

claim_text: Going from North Korea to Taiwan he is surrounded and sees the number seven, then stops because he sees a beautiful shield with the word faith written across it.
quote: I saw a shield that said F A I T H across it
falsify_match: Nothing. The seven is not attached to a unit.
falsify_miss: Nothing. Seven years, months, days or a date are all left open.

claim_text: He is told that before going into a place like Cuba it must be cultivated in prayer ahead of time, which is why he is being told in advance to hit the ground running on pioneer work.
quote: you must cultivate this more through prayer
falsify_match: Nothing. Instruction on method.
falsify_miss: Nothing. It also supplies the reason any Cuba word could be said to have failed.

claim_text: Stadiums full of people as glory domes, with the Cowboys and Minnesota Vikings stadiums named, crusades coming back like Billy Graham and massive stadiums filled with salvations across America.
quote: I see stadiums full of people that are that are glory domes
falsify_match: Stadium crusades filling NFL venues in America.
falsify_miss: None held. The Kirk memorial he cites was a single funeral, not a crusade.

claim_text: He points to a speedway holding three hundred thousand as the vision to stretch for, and calls in souls for America and Africa.
quote: Texas Motor Speedway holds like 300,000
falsify_match: A gathering of that size in America.
falsify_miss: None. The largest American religious gatherings have run in the hundreds of thousands only once or twice.

claim_text: Asia, Canada and Europe are called in as well, with a glorious outpouring over Europe.
quote: Europe will have an experience and have an GLORIOUS OUTPOURING
falsify_match: A visible religious revival across those regions.
falsify_miss: European church attendance keeps declining, as it has for decades.

claim_text: How states vote on abortion laws and legislation over the next four years decides the outcome, and it also decides how the plague goes, which can be turned like a boat through humility.
quote: This is even concerning this is concerning how the plague goes
falsify_match: A plague whose severity tracks state abortion legislation.
falsify_miss: No plague, or no such link. The condition means either outcome can be explained.

claim_text: The Lord says he will stop the Canadian legislation, that even if it has passed the house he can stop it in the Senate, and will do the same for Australia, if the persecution is cultivated against in prayer.
quote: You say it's passed in the house, I can stop it in the Senate
falsify_match: The bill fails in the Canadian Senate.
falsify_miss: It passes. All I need is just to flip it by a little sets a low bar for a claimed hit.

claim_text: He prays for great governors in Oklahoma, Texas and Florida, and identifies the African-American man with a beard he has seen over Florida as Byron Donalds, becoming governor there.
quote: I see him being a governor over Florida
falsify_match: Byron Donalds wins the Florida governorship in November 2026.
falsify_miss: He loses. He was already the endorsed front runner when this was said, which is the priority problem.

claim_text: A prayer over the man's health, finances, blood flow and arteries, that the races will be a slam dunk, and for a red wave through California as people tire of gas taxes.
quote: It's especially concerning his his blood flow
falsify_match: An arterial health problem in the man being prayed for.
falsify_miss: None. He does not say who the health prayer is for, coming straight after the Donalds passage.

claim_text: Even the most liberal Democrats say enough is enough and vote people out in California, with the same called done through Nevada, Arizona, Mexico and Colorado.
quote: there will be a great red wave
falsify_match: Republican gains across those four states in November 2026.
falsify_miss: No gains. Mexico is named alongside American states, which does not fit a midterm.

claim_text: His son plays a presidential speech about hitting Iran extremely hard over the next two to three weeks and bringing them back to the stone ages, which he says is what the Lord told him and what he gave as a prophetic word.
quote: That's what the Lord said. That's what the Lord said
time_phrase: the next two to three weeks
falsify_match: His earlier recordings contain the phrase before the speech.
falsify_miss: Back to the stone age is a common English idiom used about Iran by officials and commentators, so a match on the phrase alone proves little.

claim_text: The same passage repeated in the overlapping window, with the clip played again.
quote: I said America will say this. Remember this?
falsify_match: Same as the preceding row.
falsify_miss: Same as the preceding row.

claim_text: He says it is what the Lord said, that the Lord is bringing liberation to the people of Iran and a great revival will come across the land.
quote: I'm bringing liberation to the people of Iran
falsify_match: A change of government in Iran followed by open church growth.
falsify_miss: The government holds and the underground church stays underground.

claim_text: Noting an Indonesian earthquake, he says he is still looking for Rome and an 8.2 right outside the Vatican in the days ahead, a shaking in the soil and in the heavens.
quote: Rome will have an 8.2 right outside the Vatican
falsify_match: An earthquake of about 8.2 near Rome.
falsify_miss: No such quake. Italy has never recorded one above about 7.4, and central Italian faults cannot produce an 8.2.

claim_text: A doubling of where things were, running from Passover through the next six months, with an acceleration of events and a call to pray more.
quote: we would now see the doubling of where we were from Passover
falsify_match: A marked acceleration of the events he has named, between April and October 2026.
falsify_miss: Nothing accelerates. What doubles is never stated, which is what would have to be pinned down.

claim_text: However dark the world gets the church gets lighter, and believers must take dominion and authority or be run over, with Canada named.
quote: the church gets lighter and lighter
falsify_match: Nothing. An exhortation.
falsify_miss: Nothing. No event is named.

claim_text: Canada will not pass the persecution of the Bible in the Senate, and if the believers there humble themselves and pray the land will be healed.
quote: they will not PASS THIS THIS UNGODLY UH persecution of the Bible
falsify_match: The bill fails in the Canadian Senate.
falsify_miss: It passes. Stated as a declaration rather than a word, which softens what would count.

claim_text: He says he was warned about Canadian persecution a year ago, when he saw Trudeau getting out and Mark coming in, and that they are now seeing the fruit of it.
quote: You warned me clear back this time last year
falsify_match: The April 2025 recordings contain the warning and the succession.
falsify_miss: They do not, or they came after Carney was already the likely successor, which he was by January 2025.

claim_text: The next phase is England, with stronger persecution over not being able to say certain things, then stronger again in France, and it tries to go through Germany and Italy.
quote: I saw the next phase would be England
falsify_match: Speech restrictions on religious expression tightening in England, then France.
falsify_miss: They do not. The order is stated, which makes this more checkable than most of the persecution material.

claim_text: A great shaking in Cuba with the Castros removed and a great manifestation of glory and harvest, under a legless demonic spirit like gauze or the Grim Reaper stretching over the whole island, named as witchcraft.
quote: The Castros are going to be removed
falsify_match: The Castro family removed from Cuban public life.
falsify_miss: They remain. Raul Castro left the party leadership in 2021, so part of this has already happened.

claim_text: A named Spanish-speaking pastor in Miami goes to Cuba with a team of people around him, and the Lord says he will use whom he wants and will deliver the people of Cuba.
quote: I see a team of people coming around this man
falsify_match: That pastor leads a team into Cuba.
falsify_miss: He does not. Naming the man is what makes this checkable.

claim_text: A team of about a hundred people holding revivals across Cuba, with missionaries going in through a major window when the president liberates the island.
quote: it looked like about 100 people
falsify_match: A team of roughly that size holding revival meetings across Cuba.
falsify_miss: No team goes in. The window is conditioned on an American liberation that has not happened.
